t: You're in Finsbury Park, a public park in Harringay, in north London, on the southern edge of the borough of Haringey. It was one of the first of the great London parks laid out in the Victorian era. It borders Finsbury Park, Stroud Green and Manor House. Some notable people have local connections. The sound engineer Ken Weston, an Academy Award winner for Gladiator, was born here, and so was Baroness Sherlock. The actress Stefanie Martini lived here.
